_comment: org_uid was not a valid UUID. INITIAL_REQUEST_VALIDATION ran synchronously on the request thread, so this is the direct POST /organizations response (HTTP 200) — the async workflow never started. Since validation failed, 'source' was never resolved, so no other step rows were ever seeded — 'steps' has exactly one entry, not twelve NOT_STARTED placeholders. 'source' itself is omitted (null) for the same reason.

steps.name: INITIAL_REQUEST_VALIDATION
steps.errorMessage: org_uid must be a valid UUID
